lede: The Fourth of July weekend dominates the week, with the parade, drone show, Rundola, and a full slate of music and festivities running Friday through Saturday. Once the holiday dust settles, the most substantive government action comes Thursday, July 9, when the San Miguel County Planning Commission and Board of County Commissioners sit down together to work through proposed Land Use Code amendments covering forestry practices, oil and gas, deep geothermal operations, and condominium plats — no final votes, but these are the sessions where direction gets set.

notable.stake: LUC amendments on forestry, oil/gas, geothermal, and condo plats get shaped here.
